weakness: No account types, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; former contractor kept repository write access for 5 months
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-011, R-006; P02 AC-2
remediation_plan: Onboarding and offboarding checklist covering suite, eQMS, repository, cloud, and lab; account types and approvers in POL-02 B.1-B.2; monthly reconciliation; contractor accounts with end dates
milestones: 2026-08-11 contractor account removed; 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation
resources_required: Operations Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: Shared cloud owner account relies on the CEO's phone for MFA; firewall management login accepts a password only
remediation_plan: Named least-privilege cloud roles for daily work; break-glass owner account with its own MFA token sealed in the safe; MSP enables MFA on the firewall login
milestones: 2026-09-15 named roles; 2026-09-30 break-glass account sealed and firewall MFA evidenced

weakness: Signing key is a file on one laptop; one custodian; no requirements, two-person control, rotation plan, or tested backup; manual release
source: P07 (SC-12 objectives); P03 G-033, G-034; P01 R-001
remediation_plan: Move the signing key into an HSM-backed key service; two named approvers; release pipeline that builds, signs, and publishes with a release record; documented key ceremony and recovery; destroy the laptop and USB copies
milestones: 2026-10-31 key service and procedure approved; 2026-11-30 pipeline built; 2026-12-15 key ceremony witnessed by the QA/RA Manager; 2026-12-31 old copies destroyed
resources_required: About $1,800 a year plus about 3 weeks of engineering time

weakness: Same maintenance password on every hub; shared API key in firmware, CI logs, provisioning file, and readable on the hub; no rotation or revocation
remediation_plan: Remove the CI debug step and purge logs; rotate the API key in all environments and reflash units; per-device maintenance credentials and certificates set at the contract manufacturer; key stored in protected storage on the hub; maintenance page off by default
milestones: 2026-08-12 logs purged; 2026-09-30 API key rotated and units reflashed; 2026-12-31 per-device credentials in the design-freeze build
resources_required: Engineering time; contract manufacturer test station change (quote pending)

weakness: Inventory covers laptops only; no SBOM; units at the partner hospital not tracked

remediation_plan: Single inventory in the eQMS (laptops, lab equipment, units by serial and location, SaaS, cloud resources); SBOM generated in CI for sensor, hub, and cloud with support status and end-of-support dates
milestones: 2026-10-31 inventory; 2026-12-31 SBOM in CI for all three software items

weakness: No monitoring of device components; no scanning; dependency alerts not analyzed; no CVD or ISAO sharing
remediation_plan: Publish CVD policy and security contact; join an ISAO; weekly SBOM-based monitoring against NVD and the KEV catalog; analyze the 14 open alerts; remediation time frames by severity in the management plan
milestones: 2026-10-31 CVD published and ISAO joined; 2026-11-30 open alerts analyzed; 2026-12-31 weekly monitoring running
resources_required: About $3,500 a year (ISAO); Head of Engineering 2 hours a week

source: P07 (SA-11 objectives); P03 G-015, G-038; P01 R-003
remediation_plan: Security verification plan traced to security design inputs; static and composition analysis in CI; BLE and network fuzzing; third-party penetration test after POAM-004, then retest; privacy assessment plan for the cloud service before clinical use
milestones: 2026-11-30 plan approved; 2026-12-31 CI analysis running; 2027-01-15 penetration test report; 2027-01-31 retest

milestones: 2026-11-30 manifest in the pipeline; 2026-12-31 test station check in the quality agreement and hub logging in the design-freeze build
